paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with Tunable TM020 Mode
notes: Cavity haloscope (KAIST/IBS) TM020-mode search. Headline null-search limit: g_agamma > 12.0 x g_KSVZ at 90% CL over 21.38-21.79 ueV (5.17-5.27 GHz), from abstract, main text (p.4-5) and Fig.6. Converted via g_KSVZ = 3.912e-10 * m_a[eV] (KSVZ E/N=0, |E/N-1.92|=1.92, alpha=1/137, m_a=5.7ueV*(1e12 GeV/f_a)). Limit is flat in the g/g_KSVZ ratio so it is a nearly-flat, slightly mass-sloped line in g_agamma ~1.0e-13 GeV^-1. Assumed rho_a=0.45 GeV/cm^3 (KSVZ dark matter). A separate Bayesian analysis gives the slightly weaker 10.9 x g_KSVZ (gray shading in Fig.6 inset); reported here is the primary frequentist null-search result. Fig.6 inset shows per-bin spiky structure (linear |g/g_KSVZ| axis) but the paper's stated headline is the flat 12.0 x KSVZ bound. Abstract's '~10^-15 GeV^-1' appears to be a typo; correct value is ~10^-13 GeV^-1.
